text: Complete outage at our headquarters, no internet and no phones, business stopped.
suggested_reply: I’m sorry for the disruption — we treat this as an urgent outage and I’m escalating to our incident response team now. Please confirm the headquarters address and the best contact number for updates, and we’ll provide the next update as soon as possible.

text: The eSIM QR code does not scan, I cannot activate my line.
suggested_reply: Sorry you're unable to scan the eSIM QR — I can help get your line activated. If scanning still fails we can issue a new QR or provide the manual activation code and complete the activation from our side.
reasoning: The customer cannot scan their eSIM QR and therefore cannot complete activation—this is an activation failure requiring escalation.

text: The mobile router overheats and disconnects, still under warranty.
suggested_reply: Sorry to hear your mobile router is overheating and disconnecting. Once we have those details we’ll open an RMA and advise on next steps (repair drop-off/collection or replacement).
reasoning: The ticket describes a hardware fault (router overheating and disconnecting) and explicitly notes it's under warranty, which fits an in-warranty Device & Equipment issue requiring high priority.

text: What are the data roaming costs in the US, in EUR per GB?
